notes: UTI89 described as an ExPEC isolate in a urinary-tract study; labelled UPEC. Grown 3 h 15 min after dilution with no OD or phase word: growth_phase left out. IPTG given to all cultures; induced empty-vector WT is the control. Library kit (Nugen Ovation Prokaryotic) rRNA handling not stated.

base_medium.q: back diluted 1:100 into 5 mL LB and grown for 3 hours 15 min at 37°C, shaking 225 rpm.

growth_temperature.q: grown for 3 hours 15 min at 37°C, shaking 225 rpm.

inducer_added.q: At the two-hour growth mark IPTG was added to each culture to a final concentration of 0.1 mM.

treatment.q: Overnight cultures of UTI89/pRRK1, UTI89ΔmicC/pRRK1, and UTI89ΔmicC/pMicC were back diluted 1:100 into 5 mL LB

transcription_arrested.q: Overnight cultures of UTI89/pRRK1, UTI89ΔmicC/pRRK1, and UTI89ΔmicC/pMicC were back diluted 1:100 into 5 mL LB

mixed_organism.q: Overnight cultures of UTI89/pRRK1, UTI89ΔmicC/pRRK1, and UTI89ΔmicC/pMicC were back diluted 1:100 into 5 mL LB

strain_group.q: Extraintestinal Pathogenic Escherichia coli (ExPEC) isolate UTI89

assay_class.q: Libraries constructed using the Nugen Ovation Prokaryotic RNA-seq kit as per manufacturer instructions

global_regulator_perturbed.q: Overnight cultures of UTI89/pRRK1, UTI89ΔmicC/pRRK1, and UTI89ΔmicC/pMicC were back diluted 1:100 into 5 mL LB
